subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Mother Teresa was born in a small town called Skopje, Macedonia in 1910. Hearing a voice from within her at the age of 12, she decided to become a nun to serve God. At 18, she left her parental home and came to India, joining an Irish community of nuns, where she took her initial vows as a nun in 1931. Then from 1931 to 1948, she taught at St. Mary's High School in Kolkata. However, she felt a calling to help the poorest of the poor, and so she dedicated her life to serving the needy in the slums of Kolkata, becoming a symbol of compassion and love.
